name: Piedra Santa
notes: 4 photos: a happy hour menu, the dinner starters/salads/raw bar menu, the steaks/wagyu/sides menu, and a spirits (liquor) list. The spirits list is drink-only and skipped, as are the cocktails/wines/beer on the happy hour sheet and the steak sauce/enhancement add-ons. Overlapping items priced on both the happy hour sheet and the main menu use the main menu price; a few happy-hour-only items (oysters, sliders, mac and cheese, smaller prime steak) are kept separately.
